svg.title: Figure 09 · An intentionally inconsistent expiry pair
svg.desc: Toy smiles are constructed directly in volatility units. At k = 0, six-month total variance is 0.045 and one-year total variance is 0.0324. Under the deterministic proportional-carry framework, this violates calendar ordering.
